_comment_influx: Single InfluxDB configuration (use either this or influx_urls)

_comment_descriptions.batch_write_size: Number of data points to batch before writing to InfluxDB (default: 100)
_comment_descriptions.batch_write_interval: Maximum seconds to wait before flushing batch (default: 10)
_comment_descriptions.max_concurrent: Maximum concurrent device requests (0 = unlimited, default: 0)
_comment_descriptions.cache_ttl_seconds: Device state cache TTL in seconds (0 = disabled, default: 0)
_comment_descriptions.device_poll_intervals: Override default poll interval for specific devices (IP -> seconds)
_comment_descriptions.influx_urls: Multiple InfluxDB instances for HA/failover (lower priority = higher preference)
_comment_descriptions.influx_max_idle_conns: Maximum idle HTTP connections across all InfluxDB hosts (default: 100, 0 = use default)
_comment_descriptions.influx_max_idle_conns_per_host: Maximum idle HTTP connections per InfluxDB host (default: 10, 0 = use default)
_comment_descriptions.influx_max_conns_per_host: Maximum total HTTP connections per InfluxDB host (default: unlimited, 0 = unlimited)
_comment_descriptions.slack_webhook_url: Slack webhook URL for device offline alerts
_comment_descriptions.alerts_enabled: Enable Slack alerts for device failures
_comment_descriptions.alert_after_failures: Number of consecutive failures before sending alert
_comment_descriptions.mqtt_broker: MQTT broker URL (e.g., tcp://localhost:1883 or ssl://broker.example.com:8883)
_comment_descriptions.mqtt_client_id: MQTT client ID (optional, auto-generated if empty)
_comment_descriptions.mqtt_qos: MQTT QoS level: 0 (at most once), 1 (at least once), 2 (exactly once)
